scale: sum native RNA per grid / summed total native RNA *10000
complete_network_activity: only when every original network naming gene is measured; transcript-density proxy, not exact subtype abundance
core_activity: retains original W on prespecified 2/3 core nodes; does not rename full CM
statistics: Spearman between core gene-density vectors and directed inverse-square 60-neighbour Moran; section descriptive only
render: all retained grid locations; separately scaled plots; no cross-platform magnitude comparison
